rubric.R1: Recognisable: each rater, separately, names the object from the contact sheet alone, before reading the prompt
rubric.R2: Size: every dimension inside sizeRange (tier 4: inside 2 % of each stated size, measured on the named part)
rubric.R3: Every feature in features is present and identifiable in the contact sheet or a focus view
rubric.R4: Front: the front criterion holds (front_check clean and the named face toward +z)
rubric.R5: No open lint without a reason stated by Sage
rubric.R6: Parts named by function (accepted names below, or an equally functional name both raters accept)
rubric.R7: Plausible materials: nothing glowing, washed out or see-through by mistake

rules.itemPasses: R1-R4 all true and at least three of R5-R8
rules.bar: At least 15 of 18 items pass; every tier-1 item passes; at least 2 of 3 in tier 4 and 2 of 3 in tier 5
rules.tier1Consistency: Tier-1 items run 3 times each; an item passes with 2 of its 3 runs
rules.failures: Timeouts and refusals count as failures. A failure goes into the playbook, the cookbook or the lints, never a one-off prompt hint; then the failed items are re-run
rules.holdout: Tier 2 is a holdout: never used to tune the playbook or cookbook. After a fix round, 3 fresh holdout items are added (written down before that round's runs)

workflowGates.scope: Only the scratch layout and the site library change; no other layout, no saved user layout, no original CAD
workflowGates.immutability: A registered asset never changes; a revision registers a new version
workflowGates.replacement: A placement is replaced only when the user asked, through the normal review
workflowGates.postSaveCheck: The in-room check happens in the turn after the placement was applied or saved (show_facility_views of the new state); a shot of the earlier layout never counts
workflowGates.scoring: Gates are mandatory and scored apart from model quality

raters.blind: Runs are shuffled and labelled with random codes; raters see the contact sheet, focus views and final recipe, not the run order or the run log, until both have rated
raters.procedure: R1 first from the contact sheet alone; then the prompt is shown and R2-R8 are rated. A criterion passes only when both raters pass it; disagreements are recorded with a reason
raters.record: Per run: rounds, tool calls used of the 24, wall time against 240 s, research calls and their sources, tokens or cost where recorded, pictures, final recipe, gate results

rules.partNames: Included parts carry the include prefix ('<include name>: <part>'); E1 and R6 strip that prefix before matching
rules.environment: Every live run in a fresh conversation in a scratch layout copied from a test layout; never a user's private layout
